cases.request: What exact Aurora eligibility and supervisor-letter rules must I verify before completing the review?

evidence.text: The current Aurora grant guidance limits the co-investigator role to one named collaborator. The broader research team may still contribute without being listed as co-investigators.

A research-supervisor letter is required only when the lead applicant holds a development-scientist appointment. When required, it must confirm supervision and access to the proposed research environment.
The facilities inventory review concerns office access cards and printer maintenance. It is unrelated to the Aurora grant application.

cases.reference_output: Verify that only one named collaborator is listed as co-investigator, while other team members may contribute without that designation. Require a research-supervisor letter only if the lead applicant has a development-scientist appointment; if required, it must confirm supervision and access to the proposed research environment.
required_facts: broader team may contribute without co-investigator status

cases.request: What current Solaris export and approval rules apply, and does the 2024 pilot rule still control?

evidence.text: Effective January 2026, external analysts may access only de-identified aggregate exports after the data steward approves the request.
Legal review is required only when row-level data or a cross-border transfer is proposed. The approval order is data steward first, then legal review only when that condition applies.
The 2024 pilot allowed pseudonymized row-level exports. That pilot rule was superseded by the January 2026 policy.
The website redesign backlog covers typography and navigation. It is unrelated to Solaris data sharing.

cases.reference_output: Use the January 2026 policy: external analysts may receive only de-identified aggregate exports after data-steward approval. Legal review follows only if row-level data or a cross-border transfer is proposed. The 2024 pseudonymized row-level pilot rule was superseded and no longer controls.
required_facts: legal conditional on row-level or cross-border
